Time Recorder 2.0 (Timer 2.0)

Version 2.0.0 • Windows 11 x64 (.NET 10) Windows 11 Setup Wizard ClickOnce Auto-Updater Auto-Heal Crash Recovery Phone-Bar Dock & MySQL Sync Google Chrome Activity

High-precision Windows Forms time recording and tracking system with fault-tolerant auto-healing logs, notification tray live runtime badges, stretchable & slim Phone-Bar docking, Google Chrome activity recording, dual-table MySQL sync & compare, and interactive Dark/Light HTML reports.

⬇ Download Windows 11 Installer (TimeRecorder_2.0_Setup.exe) ⚙ Install or Update via ClickOnce (setup.exe) GitHub Repository

Install, Auto-Update & Core Capabilities

1. Windows 11 Installer & ClickOnce Auto-Updater

Download TimeRecorder_2.0_Setup.exe for the full Windows 11 Setup Wizard (Desktop & Start Menu shortcuts, optional auto-start, and Registered Apps uninstaller), or install via setup.exe for automatic background ClickOnce updates. Your local timer logs stay untouched across updates.

2. Auto-Healing Logs, Tray Badges & Phone-Bar Mode

Checkpoints active sessions every few seconds and automatically prompts to resume, close at the last timestamp, or discard interrupted sessions after a reboot or power loss. Resize narrower than 400px to snap into a compact 2×2 Phone-Bar widget beside your active work window.

3. Google Chrome Activity Logging & MySQL Dual-Table Sync

Record active Chrome window and tab titles alongside work timer runs, plus a Database Sync & Compare Panel (timer_sessions & timer_system_logs) with color-coded diff statuses (To Upload, Modified, In Sync, In DB Only).

Quick Run, Build & Test Commands

# Build & Run all 17 automated tests
dotnet build Timer20.slnx --configuration Release
dotnet test Timer20.slnx --configuration Release

# Launch Time Recorder 2.0 directly from source
dotnet run --project src/Timer2.App/Timer2.App.csproj

# Launch the Windows 11 GUI Setup Wizard or build the standalone distribution bundle
dotnet run --project src/Timer2.Installer/Timer2.Installer.csproj
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\installer\build_installer.ps1

Feature Options / Formats Description
One-Click Copy Formats H:P (4.25 hrs) • H:M (4 Hrs. 15 Min.) Copy today's running or completed total directly to the clipboard in decimal hours or hours/minutes
Dynamic Themes Dark • Light • Cyber Green • Midnight • Obsidian Instant live theme switching across the main timer, Chrome Activity, Log Viewer, and DB Sync dialogs
Interactive HTML Reports DarkHtmlTemplate • LightHtmlTemplate Exports multi-day session breakdowns with sticky summary headers, anomaly indicators, and Chrome activity correlation
